page.notes: The Greek word after "veluti" appears to be σύμβολα with an accent on the upsilon; the accent is uncertain. "melioraqúe" is read as "melioraque" with an acute over the u, which is not certain. The catchword's last letter is not clear. The reading "phyficas otii" has an i-shape uncertain (printed as "otij"). Running head read as NUNCUPATORIA with the printed V for capital U. Long s is rendered as s throughout. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
